title: Layered shadow eval fanout with phased backfill and staged soft-gates
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: We frequently see transient regressions in prompt-set smoke checks that only reproduce after replaying historical traffic. The goal of this change is to provide a deterministic, configurable shadow-eval fanout that can (1) route representative live traffic to multiple eval runners with weights, (2) run phased backfills of historical prompts in cost-aware waves, and (3) apply staged soft-gates that escalate alerts only after multi-stage consensus failures. This reduces alert noise while still catching regressions that only appear under specific sample distributions.

What this PR does (overview): Adds a new eval fanout orchestrator module (layered_shadow_fanout) that fans incoming evaluation requests to a configurable set of shadow runners (local, remote, and cached). Introduces a phased backfill controller (phased_backfill.yaml + backfill_worker) that replays historical prompt snapshots in waves with exponential decay on sampling rate. Implements a staged soft-gate adapter for CI: the gate first records divergence signals (weighted-consensus metric), then triggers a soft-alert if threshold X is exceeded for window T1, and finally escalates to a hard fail only if a secondary confidence metric is below Y for T2.

Design notes: - Fanout is layered: the primary live runner gets the request, shadow layers receive the same input with independent timeouts and isolation. Each shadow returns a score object; the orchestrator computes a weighted-consensus score and a consensus-variance signal. - Phased backfill consumes archived prompt snapshots and replays them in bounded batches. Backfill waves are parameterized: initial sample pct, decay factor, max-cost-per-hour and cohort prioritization (semantic-coverage first). - Staged soft-gates are configured via CI hooks: the first stage produces a GitHub neutral check with annotations; the second creates an annotated report and opens a quiet Linear ticket if persistent; the third marks the PR red (hard-fail) only when confirmed by consensus across at least two runners.

Checklist: - [x] Orchestrator implementation and unit tests - [x] Backfill controller with safety knobs - [x] CI hook adapter and GitHub check integration - [x] Docs: how to configure layered fanout and backfill cadence - [x] Local integration test using small snapshot - [x] Load test: 5k shadow evals/hour simulated

Backward compatibility: All APIs are additive. Existing CI hooks remain unchanged unless teams opt in to the staged gate in pipeline configs.

Rollout plan: Feature is behind a feature-flag (eval.layered_shadow_fanout). Enable in staging for 48h with a small cohort, run a 6-hour phased backfill on a 50k prompt snapshot, evaluate weighted-consensus stability and adjust thresholds before gradually enabling soft-gates for critical repos.

review_conversation:
Diego: Could the weighted-consensus metric be gamed if one shadow is consistently stale? Reply (Maya): Good catch — fanout applies a staleness penalty on out-of-window responses; implementation and tests added.

Priya: We should limit backfill cost per hour at org level as well as repo level. Reply (Maya): Added max-cost-per-hour global knob and per-cohort override in phased_backfill.yaml.

Arjun: CI hook annotations are a lot — can we surface a concise summary first? Reply (Maya): Reduced GH check summary to two lines and added a collapsible details section with full diffs. Diego approved, Priya approved with one doc nit. Final approval by Arjun after addressing documentation examples.
ci_summary: Checks: unit (pass, 14s), integration (pass, 2m 22s), lint (pass), flake-detect (pass). Backfill-sim load test run as a synthetic job (pass) with 95th p95 latency for shadow path at 120ms. No intermittent failures observed; flakiness threshold under 0.5% across runs.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash on 2025-03-20 by Maya Chen. Squash commit message summarises layered fanout, phased backfill, and CI staged gates. Release notes generated and flagged for 2025.04 minor release.
release_notes: Adds a configurable layered shadow eval fanout and phased backfill controller. New staged soft-gate CI adapter reduces false positive alerting while preserving detection of distribution-specific regressions. Opt-in via eval.layered_shadow_fanout feature flag.
